heading: Today
text: Areas of valley fog early. Lots of sun, fading behind high clouds east and south.

heading: Friday Night
text: Periods of clouds, thinner north, thicker south.

heading: Saturday
text: Showers becoming likely south of Rt. 4 and White Mountains, a chance north in the afternoon.

heading: Sunday
text: Showers likely south and east, chance north and west.
